entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-05-29
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Add support to `dotnet package` for file-based apps #49200
  • Add support for `#r "nuget: xxx"` to run-file for ease of code transfer from csx #49199
  • Provide information on the self-contained target versions #49198
  • Reduce `dotnet run` start time overhead #49197
  • [Feature] Add a `#:project` directive to `dotnet run` to include a project as a dependency #49196
  • [Feature] Proposing an option to include other C# source files for `dotnet run app.cs` #49193
  • Support PackageReference VersionOverride for `dotnet run` #49192
  • how about make `dotnet run` on a default file? #49190

PullRequests

Created

  • Support Helix testing on CentOS Stream 9 #49194
    Area-Infrastructure

Merged

  • [Blazor] Disable custom cache in .NET 10 #49183
    Area-AspNetCore, 10.0.1xx

Updated

  • Exploration of ideas for supporting multiple files in dotnet run file #47672
    Area-Infrastructure, untriaged, Area-run-file
  • stop using System.CommandLine types that aren't public anymore #49181
    Area-CLI
  • [StaticWebAsset] Exclude source maps from updating fingerprinted blazor.js #49178
    Area-AspNetCore, 10.0.1xx
  • File watcher: ignore directories, allow watching non-recursively #49150
    Area-AspNetCore
  • [WiX 5] Migrate SDK from v3 to v5 #48699
  • Enable container tests #48910
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #49080
    Area-CodeFlow, Area-Roslyn
  • dotnet CLI: Add --cli-schema option for CLI structure JSON #49118
    Area-CLI
  • [release/10.0.1xx-preview5] Fix minimum width of Author column in tabular output #49169
